summary: Mullin frames Gaza around Israel's right to self-defense and a two-state solution while urging ceasefires and humanitarian aid. His votes include supporting $14 billion in weapons to Israel in April 2024, codifying the IHRA definition that equates anti-Zionism with antisemitism, and the Antisemitism Awareness Act, yet later backing the Massie amendment to cut $3.3 billion in military aid. Vote for Peace opposed him in the general, and his USCPR scorecard reads F.
